svg.title: OneGrid multiregion business continuity and disaster recovery
svg.desc: A primary region and a standby recovery region in the landing zone, with hub, management and workload subscriptions per region, the Microsoft Fabric tenant, and the recovery paths between them.

g.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: OneGrid multiregion business continuity and disaster recovery
A primary region and a standby recovery region in the landing zone, with hub, management and workload subscriptions per region, the Microsoft Fabric tenant, and the recovery paths between them.

Letters A–J match the design areas in the multiregion article; B2–J2 mark the recovery copies. Dashed lines are gated, disabled, optional or recovery paths. Address ranges are examples.
